About Coziwalls

Room to settle in. Space to move forward.

Coziwalls Co-Living is preparing shared housing to serve Wilmington, Delaware; Baltimore, Maryland; and Washington, D.C.

Our vision is a comfortable, respectful home environment where residents can build routines, connect with neighbors and focus on their next chapter. We are developing both general shared housing and recovery-focused housing options.

We are in the pre-opening stage. Amenities, locations and opening timelines will be confirmed as plans are finalized.

Planned Home Features

Everyday comfort, thoughtfully considered

Our planned shared-housing offering includes the essentials that make moving into a new home simpler. Final features will vary by property and will be confirmed before any move-in.

  • Furnished sleeping spaces
  • Utilities
  • Wi-Fi
  • Shared kitchen
  • Common living areas
  • Peer community

Monthly housing fee details are shared in a private conversation.

Our Community

Housing with a sense of belonging

Our initial plans focus on men's shared housing, with particular attention to welcoming veterans. We are also preparing recovery-focused housing options.

Shared Living

A welcoming setting for people seeking furnished housing and community connection.

Veteran Connections

We aim to be a useful housing resource for veterans and the organizations supporting them.

Recovery-Focused Options

Planned sober housing with peer community and a stable home environment. Housing is not clinical care.

For Community Partners

Let's build referral relationships before opening

We welcome introductions from veteran service organizations, VA-related community contacts, case managers, housing navigators, reentry organizations and recovery support networks.

Tell us what housing needs your clients are experiencing. We can share our planned resident profile and discuss a future referral process as operations take shape.

Important: We are not currently advertising available rooms or accepting immediate placements.

Frequently Asked Questions

Helpful answers

Are your homes open now?

Not yet. Coziwalls Co-Living is preparing to open. Contact us to express interest and request updates.

What locations will you serve?

Our planned service areas are Wilmington, Delaware; Baltimore, Maryland; and Washington, D.C. Exact property addresses will be shared after screening when locations are confirmed.

What will the monthly housing fee include?

We plan to offer furnished shared housing with core amenities. The exact features and monthly housing fee will be discussed privately once a specific home is confirmed.

Do you offer recovery-focused housing?

We are planning recovery-focused housing as well as general shared housing. We provide housing, not medical or clinical services.

Can an organization refer someone now?

We welcome referral-partner conversations now, but cannot confirm a placement until a home is open and an individual screening has been completed.

Be among the first to hear from us

Interested in housing or connecting as a referral partner? Introduce yourself and we will keep the conversation going as our plans develop.
